data.optimizer_sees: train 80 (official split train), in mini-batches of K=4: for each task the Reflector sees the instruction, the lowest-scoring of 3 trials' transcript (<= 20k chars) and final code, the k-trial scores and the scorer's gold-safe feedback; the Curator sees the Reflector outputs + task contexts (task_id, instruction_type, answer_position, instruction). Never gold values, never test ids.
data.selects_on: val 40 (official split val): val 40 x 3 at each epoch end (and one final one when R stops training); champion = upstream's best-val-accuracy rule (strict >, starting at 0.0)
data.aggregate_feedback_to_optimizer_from_val: none (val scores only select the checkpoint)
data.test: never loaded (test_samples=None); the launcher asserts zero overlap of train/val ids with the official test list

settings.flow: ACEBatch offline, batch_size K=4, curator_num_groups=floor(sqrt(4))=2, augmented_shuffling factor 2
settings.eval_steps: len(train) = one val evaluation per epoch end
settings.skill_bullets: on ([skill]/[script] -> skills/ace-playbook/); SKILL_BULLETS=0 is the text-only ablation

post_smoke_edits: lsf_ace_search.sh: + export PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1 (arm.log was block-buffered during the smoke; no behaviour change)
